reviews.title: A
reviews.text: It’s pretty accurate but I can’t get my exact location it freezes up when I do that. I can only lock in the town I live In. An I fish 80 miles offshore so I have to come up with my own formula to when the fish are actually gonna bite really these app are not useful I can just look this stuff up on google an chat gpt an get more accurate information

reviews.title: This app sucks
reviews.text: Every time I open it, it forgets that I purchased it.  Then when I go and hit the “Restore in app purchases” within the app, so that it will give me access again, it just spins and never completes.  I paid for this app yet I can’t access.  Don’t waste your money.
